concept.definition: A quantity sample type that measures the amount of active energy the user has burned.
A quantity sample type that measures the amount of time the user spent exercising.
A quantity sample type that measures the amount of time the user has spent performing activities that involve full-body movements during the specified day.

A quantity sample type that measures the amount of time the user has spent standing.
A quantity sample type that measures the resting energy burned by the user.

A quantity sample type measuring the user's speed while cycling.
Captures distance travelled by the user since the last reading.
Captures the elevation gained by the user since the last reading.
Captures the user's steps cadence. Each record represents a series of measurements.
